provenance.method: Actual unmodified createEPG HTTP handler via existing epg-fixture fixture/invoke. In-memory HTTP request/response and upstream streams only; real SAX XML parser, UTF-8 decoder, gzip decoder, shared core, limits and serialization. No parser/reducer algorithms copied and no production injection.
